explanation: The Almighty Creator who, according to Genesis, created the heavens, the earth, and all life.
The term used to describe God's act of bringing the universe and everything in it into existence.
A future time when God will judge all nations for their injustice and sin.
A time when people gather with sorrow, prayer, and repentance over their own sins.
To completely ruin or wipe something out of existence as punishment for evil.
An attitude of humility and meekness where one puts God at the center rather than oneself.
The few faithful who survive God's judgment because they have sought righteousness and demut.
